note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guides are written in our own words for this entry; each cites the sources its facts come from. Where no source has confirmed the exact steps yet, the guide says so plainly.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum, so there is no separate task: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. Work through the roadmap in order — story first, then the 100% checklist, then side characters and clean-up — and it will be the last trophy you earn. PowerPyx puts the whole run at about 200 hours and rates it 4/10 in difficulty: long, not hard.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, one of the first missions of Chapter 1. It is a story trophy, so it cannot be missed — just play the opening missions in order and it pops when the mission ends. GTABase lists it as the first story trophy of the game.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through every mission of Chapter 1. The trophy is awarded as Chapter 2 begins, once you have played the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, according to GTABase. Before you leave Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation the morning after Down to Earth — that one interaction may matter for Positive Mental Attitude.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish all of Chapter 2's missions. GTABase reports the trophy is awarded as Chapter 3 begins, after the Welcome to Vice City mission. Chapter 2 is also where both Jason and Lucia become playable together, which opens up the partner trophies and most side activities.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 3 to its end, including The Cartel Heist. GTABase notes the trophy arrives after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Chapter 3 is a good time to start the robbery tools and side-character quest lines that open here.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 4, including Child's Play, Headliners and VCIA Takedown. It is a story trophy and cannot be missed. Bank vaults open up in this chapter, so start the Maximum Withdrawal work while the chapter's missions are fresh.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the last mission of the story. GTABase confirms there is no mission replay, but no trophy depends on how you play a mission, so any completion counts. Free roam carries on after the credits, so the whole clean-up phase of the roadmap starts from here.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 mission. It is a story trophy that unlocks by playing the mission to its end, and it cannot be missed. GTABase places it in Chapter 2, early in the stretch where both protagonists are playable.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. Like the other mission trophies it pops when the mission ends and cannot be missed. GTABase lists it as a Chapter 3 story trophy.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play in Chapter 4. It is a story trophy, so finishing the mission is all it takes and it cannot be missed. GTABase confirms the mission and chapter.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners in Chapter 4. A story trophy: play the mission through to its end and it pops. GTABase lists it alongside the other Chapter 4 mission trophies.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. It is a story trophy that cannot be missed — finish the mission and it unlocks. The mission's airport setting is also where the Catch Me If You Can trophy is earned in free roam.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. A story trophy that pops when the mission ends and cannot be missed. GTABase places it in the final chapter, shortly before the last mission.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion using the in-game checklist under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, which only appears after the story — but anything you did before the credits already counts. Both GTABase and PowerPyx call this the hardest trophy and stress that the checklist is lenient, closer to 60% true completion: it needs all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting-range golds, drone races and Bret's Target Decks in full, but only a share of the rest — 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges and 300 stunts. Nothing on the checklist is missable.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts, in any mix: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. GTABase says flying under bridges is the quickest way to rack them up, and the optional challenge on each stunt is not needed. Check your count under Progress > Activities > Stunts; the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this trophy.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race (a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race) and a stunt. GTABase notes that Progress > Activities shows what is left, and most of these come naturally while chasing the other activity trophies.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge: 42 golds across 12 ranges, according to GTABase. The ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger. PowerPyx notes the gold medals are not too difficult, and the 100% checklist needs all 42 anyway, so this trophy and A Long Road share the same work.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — one win per location is enough for this trophy. GTABase adds that the 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so it is worth finishing each location while you are there rather than coming back later.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; GTABase counts 40 races to choose from, and winning the same race again does not count. Race wins also feed Master of None, and the 100% checklist asks for 30 unique race wins, so keep racing past this trophy toward that higher count.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After you meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon. Play through his fishing quests and beat him in his challenge, as GTABase describes. Fishing itself also counts toward Master of None, so this trophy doubles as one of its nine activities.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Reach the end of any one arcade game. GTABase names the four: three of them (Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind) are on the TV at home, and the fourth, Bang For Your Buck, is on arcade cabinets around Leonida. Pick whichever you find easiest and play it to the end.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's quests are Lucia-only and start in Chapter 3, when he texts her an address in Belville. GTABase lists all five in order: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — the last one awards the trophy. They stay available after the story, so there is no rush.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton (green KR icon in Key Lento) hires you in Chapter 1 to recover treasure from 7 shipwrecks. GTABase says to dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig the treasure up, tracking progress under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures. He disappears after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again later, so you can finish the line then.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. GTABase reports the fifth job, Hometown Heroes, unlocks the trophy, and the jobs stay available after the story.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands. GTABase confirms Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count, while the quest lines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not, and notes the remaining qualifying strands are still being confirmed — so check the trophy's progress counter in your trophy list as you go. None of the strands are needed for 100%, and all stay available after the story.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission that gets you the Key Cloner (Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS). GTABase says to deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City (RK icon), scanning cars with the WAiNK app to see if they are on the list — hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the best places to look, and cars in better condition pay more.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, Tyrone has you destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City. GTABase reports that once enough are gone, his last job (Shut Down the Labs) awards the trophy.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every Meditation Spot until the counter reaches 18; GTABase counts 18 spots, and meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice, with the last one needing both characters, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. POSSIBLY MISSABLE — the only trophy PowerPyx and GTABase flag: in Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony and accept her meditation. It is gone after Chapter 1, and it is not confirmed yet whether the trophy needs it, so do it anyway. Note the 100% checklist only needs 15 of the 18 spots, so this trophy is stricter than A Long Road.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's hunting quests start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: he texts Jason, and Veteran Hunted in Lummox County kicks things off. GTABase says to hunt the animals on his Target Decks (purple icons) and bring them back as Jason, and notes a clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required. Which animal triggers the trophy is not confirmed yet; the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway, so finishing them all covers it.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets — you do not need all of them. GTABase notes the Collections section of the Progress menu shows how close each set is. The 100% checklist needs 15 of the 18 card sets, so keep collecting past this trophy.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up on the D-pad, then R1 / RB). GTABase says any 100 count, drawn from the 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags. Scanning also feeds Whip It Good and Randy's car list, so do it whenever you pass a new area.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges; GTABase notes Progress > Challenges marks finished ones with a tick, and many complete themselves while you play. The 100% checklist needs 70, so this trophy comes along the way — PowerPyx adds that needing only 70 of 80 lets you skip the hardest challenges.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Possible once both characters are together (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2). GTABase says to call your partner (hold Right on the D-pad, then Triangle / Y), get a 4-star Wanted Level and escape — it only counts once you are out of the red heat zone. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters well, and bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so it often unlocks there.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while you are still wanted (flashing red and blue). GTABase advises going in with body armor, sticky bombs and healing items, and notes the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3) are close together. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to appear after the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app — you do not need to drive them. GTABase suggests standing next to a busy road and scanning passing traffic. The 100% checklist needs 200 base models, so you will get this anyway on the way to A Long Road.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single Combat Focus (click both sticks while aiming). GTABase warns it only lasts a few seconds, so fill your Focus first (eat, drink or wash up at home; Adrenaline makes it last longer) and use an assault rifle. Gang operation thugs work well; cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, steal one of the big passenger jets docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge — planes parked out on the airfield do not count. GTABase says to back it out, take off and get about 1 km away from the airport, and names gates E3 and E4 as the easiest: drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station on the southwest island of Mariana County — GTABase places the tanks at the south end of the base — and take out enemies from inside it until the trophy pops. The Rhino is the tank the description is joking about, so expect a fight getting in and out.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 give you the Snap Gun. GTABase says to use it on a jewelry store's locked back door (kicking it in sets off the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room, and empty the safe without being spotted. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City works well, according to the same guide.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Bank vaults open up with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…. GTABase explains the loop: follow a security van to its bank and get into the vault while it is open; the haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner. Vaults always give 4 stars, so escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles. Five of the 8 vaults are enough here, but the 100% checklist needs all 8, and each pays up to $205,000; Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. GTABase notes robbing a bank vault (see Maximum Withdrawal) counts, as long as you then escape the red heat zone or get to a Pay 'n' Spray — but before vaults open, you can box in an armored truck, put a sticky bomb on its back doors, blow them open and get away.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map of Leonida. GTABase says the quickest way is by plane, flying over every dark patch. This pairs naturally with the stunts, WAiNK scans and vehicle discoveries, so work on it while travelling between other objectives rather than as a separate grind.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal gang operation (yellow map icons) from each of the 9 gangs; GTABase notes Progress > Gangs keeps count. The 100% checklist needs all 39 operations, so this trophy is the first third of that longer job — keep robbing past it.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach in Vice City — that is what the official description asks for. GTABase is honest that the exact steps are not confirmed yet, and so are we: no source we checked has pinned down which bar or prompt triggers it, so try the beachfront bars on Ocean Beach and watch for the interaction. We will update this guide when a source confirms it.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The description points to crashing a car out through the window of a vehicle showroom, in the style of the classic GTA intro the name is nodding to. GTABase says the exact steps are not confirmed yet, and neither PowerPyx nor any other source we checked has confirmed which showroom or exit triggers it — so we are not inventing one. Try driving a car through a showroom's front window and see if it pops; we will update this guide when a source confirms the method.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation, first marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2. GTABase says to take its three valuables: the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table, and the safe in the northeast hallway (bring sticky bombs). The trophy pops once you lose the police. You do not need all three in one visit, but the robbery takes a long time to come back.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia (Jason & Lucia > Strength in the pause menu). GTABase says to work out at fitness clubs (Map > Activities) with your partner along, since training one trains the other too, and after the story you can also train at home. It is a slow grind, so start early and top it up between other jobs.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. GTABase reports most players get it without trying, and advises turning on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI to watch the count. Do not push towards the Irredeemable profile on purpose: GTABase and PowerPyx both say it is permanent.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: "Second time's the charm" suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt — that is all the official description gives away. GTABase lists the exact steps as not confirmed yet, and PowerPyx likewise lists this trophy as not yet known, so we will not guess at a method. Play normally and it may pop on a retry somewhere; we will update this guide when a source confirms how it triggers.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Expect a strange event or Easter egg somewhere in Leonida — the description reads like a reaction to something weird, and the name points at the unexplained. GTABase says the exact steps are not confirmed yet, and PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known, so no source we checked can say where or what it is. Keep an eye out while exploring; we will update this guide when a source confirms the trigger.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The description points to knocking people down with a melee attack from a vehicle — a melee drive-by, as the name Ten Pin (bowling them over like pins) suggests. GTABase says the exact steps are not confirmed yet, and PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet known, so the number of people, the vehicle and the weapon are all unconfirmed. Try melee attacks from a slow-moving vehicle in a crowded spot; we will update this guide when a source confirms the method.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) in Chapter 3 gets you the Dye Pack Jammer, according to GTABase. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to fences — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. It is a running total, so the robberies for 100% get you there without a separate grind.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a running total of $100,000 across every kind of shop. GTABase notes guns, car mods and tattoos use it up fastest, and the money you spend here also feeds the other money trophies. Buy the gear you actually want for the robbery and shooting-range work first, and the total will take care of itself.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy the 8 garages for sale in the Vice City Real Estate phone app (available after Daily Driver in Chapter 2), for about $160,000 in total, according to GTABase. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count, so only the purchased ones matter — and the extra space is what On the Spot needs for registering vehicles.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Moses' Chapter 2 mission gets you the app, per GTABase: take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray them and register them. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones. You need free garage space (see Little Boxes) and each registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
